program_narrative: Program INQPORT is an online CICS program that answers a portfolio position inquiry. It copies the caller's communication area (DFHCOMMAREA, layout INQCOM) into working storage, registers CICS condition handlers (ERROR to P999-ERROR-ROUTINE, NOTFND to P900-NOT-FOUND), and reads the VSAM file POSFILE into WS-POSITION-RECORD (layout POSREC) by a key taken from an account-number field; both the source and key field names (WS-COMMAREA-ACCOUNT-NO, POSITION-ACCOUNT) are not declared anywhere, so the key mapping is unknown. If the read response is NORMAL, the position is shown on screen map POSMAP of mapset INQSET; otherwise the message 'Position not found for account' is placed in the communication area returned to the caller. The program then returns to CICS. The error routine P999-ERROR-ROUTINE, which sets 'Error accessing position data' and the response code in the communication area, is reachable only through the CICS ERROR handler. The SQL include SQLPOS is unresolved, but no procedure statement uses it.

pseudocode: -- Online CICS entry point: caller data arrives in DFHCOMMAREA (no PROCEDURE DIVISION USING)
CALL p100-init-program THRU p100-exit  !! PERFORM THRU: runs P100-INIT-PROGRAM then P100-EXIT
CALL p200-get-position THRU p200-exit  !! PERFORM THRU: runs P200-GET-POSITION then P200-EXIT
IF position exists (WS-POSITION-FOUND = 'Y') THEN
CALL p300-format-display THRU p300-exit  !! PERFORM THRU
ELSE
CALL p900-not-found THRU p900-exit  !! PERFORM THRU
END IF
CICS RETURN TO caller

pseudocode: SET position_account (POSITION-ACCOUNT OF WS-POSITION-RECORD) = ws_commarea_account_no  -- !! both data names are undeclared (see annotations)
CICS READ file POSFILE
KEY: position_account
INTO: ws_position_record
RESPONSE CODE → ws_response_code
IF ws_response_code = NORMAL THEN  -- DFHRESP(NORMAL)
SET position exists flag (WS-POSITION-FOUND = 'Y')
ELSE
SET no position flag (WS-POSITION-FOUND = 'N')
END IF
